definition: Zeynep Akata is a Liesel Beckmann Distinguished professor of computer science at the Technical University of Munich where she leads the Interpretable and Reliable Machine Learning chair.
details: Akata is also the director of the Helmholtz Institute for Explainable Machine Learning.

explainer.lead: Zeynep Akata is a Liesel Beckmann Distinguished professor of computer science at the Technical University of Munich, where she leads the Interpretable and Reliable Machine Learning chair. She also directs the Helmholtz Institute for Explainable Machine Learning.

tiers.eli5: Like a professor who runs a lab focused on making AI systems understandable and trustworthy.
tiers.practitioner: Her work centers on interpretable and reliable machine learning, the concerns engineers face when deploying models that must be explained and trusted.
tiers.paperLevel: Her roles are the Liesel Beckmann Distinguished professorship at the Technical University of Munich, leading the Interpretable and Reliable Machine Learning chair, and directing the Helmholtz Institute for Explainable Machine Learning.
